subject: Re: Sticker adhesion failures — split-ship & reprint options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@stickitlabs.co>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: URGENT: QC flagged — venue reported sticker adhesion failure

Hi Oliver / team,

We just received a QC email from the venue (Civic Center) — several hundred of the event stickers we shipped are failing to adhere to fabric/lanyard backs within 24 hours. Attached are photos from the venue ops. This is the run we received last night: 1,500 units, red gloss die-cut.

We need options and costs ASAP, ideally by EOD PST:
- Can you confirm root cause (material vs adhesive batch)?
- If reprint required, lead time for full reprint (cost and qty breakouts).
- Fastest path to get at least 150 units to the venue tomorrow AM (split-ship + overnight courier) so the activation team has something to hand out.
- Any mitigations (lamination, different liner/adhesive) and sample/test turnaround.

Attaching: adhesion_test_photos.zip (venue photos).

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Field Marketing Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@stickitlabs.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: URGENT: QC flagged — venue reported sticker adhesion failure

Hi Marcus / Lauren,

Thanks for the heads up and the photos — sorry to hear about the issue. We ran a quick bench test against the lot and the failure mode matches a batch where the liner release agent changed slightly on the supplier side (subtle surface energy difference). We should have caught this in preflight; that's on us.

Options and estimates:
1) Standard reprint with 3M 300LSE adhesive (recommended): 6 business days, $0.12/unit for 1,500 units (material + labor).
2) Expedited 48-hour reprint (rush run): 2 business days, 45% rush fee on top of standard unit price.
3) Quick split-ship: we can do 150 units overnight courier to the venue tomorrow AM for $120 (flat overnight fee + handling). We will also include adhesion-test swatches for venue ops to verify.

We attached an updated art/lamination proof (sticker_proof_v2.pdf) showing the revised recommended adhesive spec and a short adhesion test log.

If you approve split-ship, we can pull 150 units from a recently completed adjacent lot that passed adhesion (quantity confirmed). For the reprint remainder, we recommend option 1 unless you instruct otherwise.

Again — apologies. We will absorb standard reprint QC retest costs, but rush fees are typically charged. If you want us to waive the rush fee, we can escalate internally; we need written approval from Redwood to proceed if you want us to cover the overnight.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Operations Manager | Stick-It Labs
oliver@stickitlabs.co | +1 503-555-0123

Attach: sticker_proof_v2.pdf, adhesion_test_photos.zip
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

We need to proceed on two tracks:

Civic Center Event Hall
Receiving / Activation — Attn: Sara Mendez
123 Mission St.
San Francisco, CA 94103

Oliver — please waive the rush fee for the overnight shipment; this is vendor QC on your end. If you need a formal credit note or escalation, flag it here and we can submit a complaint ticket to your account manager.

Thanks all — cc'd Sara at venue so they have the heads up.

Lauren Bishop | Events Lead | Redwood Inference
